title: Reasoning effort
text: min_effort is the row threshold; actual effort resolves session membership. Effort order is none < minimal < low < medium < high < xhigh (extra-high) < max < ultra. Native embedded effort may fill missing facts; speed suffixes are ignored. Unknown models or unpublished efforts resolve no level and work claims/launches refuse session_below_intern; refresh catalog/native facts or select a supported model and effort before retrying.
